en: Spain colonized the Philippines for 333 years, which is nearly seven times longer than the 48-year American colonial period.
The Philippine Senate has exactly 24 members elected nationwide, while the House of Representatives has over 300 local representatives.
National hero Jose Rizal was only 35 years old when executed, having written two groundbreaking novels before his death.
Juan Luna’s famous painting Spoliarium measures 4.22 meters by 7.64 meters, making it the largest canvas in the Philippines.
Dr. Fe del Mundo lived to be 100 years old, famously becoming the first Asian admitted to Harvard Medical School.
The official Philippine national flag follows a strict 1:2 ratio, meaning its length is exactly twice its width.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, but only Filipino and English are designated as official languages for government and education.
The Philippine eagle, our national bird, boasts a wingspan of up to 2 meters, wider than an average child's height.
The indigenous Igorot people carved the Banaue Rice Terraces, which would stretch over 10,000 kilometers if laid end to end.
The annual Sinulog Festival in Cebu features a grand parade with thousands of dancers, attracting over a million tourists annually.
The Philippine Supreme Court is composed of exactly 15 justices, including one Chief Justice and 14 Associate Justices.
The Philippines celebrated its 125th year of independence in 2023, marking exactly 125 years since the 1898 proclamation in Kawit.
